items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Mary Lou Williams) does not mention Piney Brown in her own turns. The mention appears only in the interviewer's narration ('He and Piney Brown were really friends of the musicians').

ctx.x: This was the time when Martha was supposed to go to Hollywood and she wouldn't leave?
Yes, she wouldn't leave. She stayed about 2 weeks. She was supposed to just drop off and change trains in Kansas City but she heard about Piney Brown's place and she wanted to see it.
Oh, I see, this was the first time she had ever been there?
